stem:
The best time to obtain a clear image of chromosomes during a mitotic cell cycle is during the metaphase stage.

Fig. 6.1 is a scanning electron micrograph of a group of human chromosomes at metaphase.

{{figure:figure_6_1.webp}}

Fig. 6.1

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The group of chromosomes shown in Fig. 6.1 is magnified many times.

The actual width of the human chromosome between **A-B** is $1400\text{nm}$.

Calculate the magnification of the scanning electron micrograph shown in Fig. 6.1.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Draw chromosome **C** in Fig. 6.1 in the space provided.

Label your drawing to show the structure of the chromosome.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Suggest why the metaphase stage is the best time during a mitotic cell cycle to obtain a clear image of chromosomes.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Name the stage of mitosis that immediately follows metaphase.
